'''Landing Platform 21''' was docking port in [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]] on [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]].

==History==
In [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], a [[Transport/Legends|transport]], operated by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Shemza]]'s [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance]] contact, was berthed at the platform. After [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] announced the presence of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] over the city's [[Intercom/Legends|intercom]], Shemza, [[Shorty (droid)|Shorty]], [[Rorworr (Naboo)|Rorworr]], [[Galak]], and [[Arani Korden]] fought to gain access to the platform and escape the occupied city.
